fact: The Joint SDG Fund programme's final report of 26 July 2022 states that a Single Process module was developed in DHIS2 using the unique social ID of beneficiaries, that data for 21,668 Social Registry beneficiaries were loaded into DHIS2 for four of the six districts, and that subsidised care tracked through it began in April 2022 as a pilot in three district health units; it adds that DHIS2 implementation was supported by the University of Oslo, Gavi and the Global Fund, with AFD and Canadian cooperation buying IT equipment.
title: Joint Programme Final Narrative Report: Reaching the furthest behind first: A catalytic approach to supporting the social protection in Sao Tome & Principe
